sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-GN key (RB-GN) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Federal State Reserve Agency base Airspace Control Center bunker generator room.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Basement level of the Airspace Control Center (king) on Reserve. (Highlighted in green)

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Two Toolboxes
- Possible spawn of FP-100 filter absorber
- Possible spawn of 6-STEN-140-M military battery
- Possible spawn of Old firesteel
